item.title: Angelo State Golf Opens 2026 at the Jack Brown Invitational
item.description: LAREDO, TX — The Angelo State Rambelles opens its 2026 spring season Monday and Tuesday at the Jack Brown Invitational, hosted by Texas A&M International Dustdevils.The 54-hole tournament will be contested Feb. 2–3 at Lakecliff Country Club in Spicewood, Texas, with teams playing 36 holes Monday followed by a final 18-hole round Tuesday. Learn More Here.

item.title: Texas Concrete Supplier Files for Bankruptcy, Cites ICE as Key Factor in Financial Collapse
item.description: MISSION, TX — A major concrete supplier in the Rio Grande Valley has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, with its CEO directly attributing the decision to labor shortages caused by intensified federal immigration enforcement actions.57 Concrete, headquartered in Mission and a primary supplier for residential and commercial construction projects across the region, filed for bankruptcy last month. Learn More Here.

item.title: Here's Why You Don't Take Selfies with Snow Leopards
item.description: KOKTOKAY, CHINA — A female tourist was mauled by a rare snow leopard in northwest China’s Xinjiang region after she left her vehicle and approached the animal to take photographs, authorities said.The attack occurred about 7 p.m. Jan. 23 in Koktokay, a popular ski destination in the Altay prefecture, as the woman was returning to her hotel after a day on the slopes. Learn More Here.

item.title: WATCH: Bonham Elementary Celebrates 40th Anniversary with Unveiling of New Sheep Statue
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Bonham Elementary School marked its 40th anniversary Friday with a ribbon-cutting ceremony and the unveiling of a new painted sheep statue on campus. Learn More Here.

item.title: Road Construction to Restrict Lanes on Edmund Boulevard in San Angelo
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Roadway construction on Edmund Boulevard and West 29th Street will begin Monday and continue through mid-February, the city announced Friday. The work will affect the section between Howard Street and the North Concho River bridge. Two-way traffic will be maintained with one lane open in each direction. item.title: Irion County Tops Bronte to Make Move in Crazy District Race
item.description: BRONTE, TX — You won’t find a more competitive playoff race in boys basketball than what’s going on in District 11-1A this season.Irion County’s 46-29 win over Bronte on Friday was evidence of that as it propelled the Hornets from fifth place into a three-way tie for third with Garden City and Robert Lee. Learn More Here.

item.title: Robert Lee Takes Down Veribest in Double OT Thriller
item.description: ROBERT LEE, TX — It took all of regulation, plus two overtime periods, but the Robert Lee Steers survived Veribest to claim a district win on Friday night, 49-46.The Steers' Brenner Sherwood put the team on his back in overtime, tying the game in the first OT period with a three-pointer with under 30 seconds to play. In the second OT period, he then scored eight of Robert Lee's nine points to secure the victory for the Steers. With the win, Robert Lee keeps their playoff hopes alive. Learn More

item.title: Menard Sophomore Seeks Votes in National Wool Contest
item.description: MENARD, TX — A Menard High School sophomore is representing Texas in the junior division of the 2026 National Make It With Wool competition and is competing for the division’s social media award, with public voting closing Saturday afternoon. Makenzie Wright’s entry is among those featured in the junior social media contest post on the National Make It With Wool Facebook page. Learn More Here.
